questions.question_text: He changes 2500 rand into Swiss francs (CHF). 1 Swiss franc = 12.43 rand. Calculate the amount Toby receives in Swiss francs. Give your answer correct to the nearest Swiss franc.

Toby leaves Johannesburg at 1930 and arrives in Zurich at 0610 the next morning. Local time in Zurich is the same as local time in Johannesburg. The distance from Johannesburg to Zurich is 8350 km. Calculate the average speed of the journey.
After arriving at 0610, Toby takes a further 1 hour 55 minutes to reach his office. Work out the time he arrives at his office.

Later, Toby takes a taxi from his office to a hotel. The taxi fare is made up of a fixed charge of 20 CHF plus 2.40 CHF per kilometre. Toby paid 36.80 CHF altogether. Work out the distance of Toby's taxi journey.
